title: Crypto Tracker
subtitle: Live cryptocurrency tracker with coin details, price charts, and an adaptive multi-pane layout for phones and tablets.

sections.description: Built as a reference project to explore Android's latest best practices. Crypto Tracker pulls live coin data and displays it with a clean list-detail UI. On tablets, it uses Adaptive Navigation for a proper multi-pane experience.
features: Live cryptocurrency list with price & change data
Detail view with price chart per coin
Adaptive Navigation — single/dual pane based on screen size
MVI architecture for predictable state management
